thesisCurrent: CivicState sells citation-backed civic letters; invest only after paid demand and delivery validation.

authority.adoption: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

sources.usedFor: product spec, infrastructure, business model, deferred scope
customer definition, constraints, validation gates, assumptions
value chain, distribution hypothesis, moat hypothesis
phase narrative and claimed completion status
pricing tiers and Stripe Checkout implementation

methods: Workspace-only repository review; no network research performed.
Existing product narrative preserved and contradicted signals called out as Surprise Spikes.
Every external market or competitor claim treated as an assumption.
Financial model built bottom-up from implemented pricing tiers and stated/planned cost assumptions.

freshness.stalenessRisk: High: repo planning files conflict on whether Phase 1 only or all four phases are complete.

limitations: No production revenue, conversion, traffic, deliverability, or official response evidence found.
No external market research due workspace-only instruction.
Project identity mismatch between dispatch project id and repo product name.

customerDefinition.primaryCustomer: US residents with specific civic concerns who need help with official targeting, citations, drafting, and delivery.
excludedCustomers: Medical or sensitive-content users outside civic correspondence
customerDefinition.honesty: Repo-backed for target description; willingness to pay remains unvalidated.

revenueModel.honesty: Tier prices are repo evidence; mix, costs, orders, and margin are assumptions.

marketSizing.method: bottom-up validation model, not top-down TAM
marketSizing.honesty: All traffic, conversion, and volume values are assumptions because network and production data were unavailable.

competition.name: Resistbot
competition.risk: Free or low-friction constituent messaging may be good enough.

competition.name: Change.org
competition.risk: Petition/social distribution may feel more powerful than paid letters.

competition.name: Quorum
competition.risk: Enterprise civic advocacy tools own organization budgets.

competition.name: VoterVoice
competition.risk: Advocacy campaign platforms can activate constituents at scale.

competition.name: LegalZoom
competition.risk: Consumer document brands may be trusted more, despite CivicState avoiding legal advice.

competition.name: Manual official email and free templates
competition.risk: Free alternatives compress willingness to pay.

risksAntiPlan: Users may not pay for a civic communication task they can do manually for free.
A single fabricated or misleading citation can destroy trust.
Government inbox deliverability may fail before SEO or paid demand matters.
Human moderation and official-data cleanup may consume the apparent gross margin.
The registry warning may mean this should not be pitched as an investible business.

assumptionLedger.assumption: Users will pay 5 to 25 USD for letter delivery.

assumptionLedger.validation: Track wizard starts, previews, and paid checkouts.

assumptionLedger.assumption: Official email bounce rate can stay below 10 percent.
assumptionLedger.validation: Measure domain-level bounces and pause risky domains.

assumptionLedger.assumption: SEO pages can produce meaningful acquisition.
assumptionLedger.validation: Publish only opt-in real campaign pages and measure impressions.

assumptionLedger.assumption: One operator can manage review within 24 hours.
assumptionLedger.validation: Track flagged queue age and review minutes.

goToMarket.primary: SEO from opt-in public campaign pages after real paid submissions exist.
goToMarket.secondary: Social sharing from campaign pages and official reply updates.
nearTermTests: Measure conversion, bounce rate, official response rate, complaints, refunds, and review time.
goToMarket.honesty: Channel claims are assumptions until analytics exist.

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Even beta users may not represent scalable demand.

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Warm domain, track bounces, pause domains above 10 percent bounce.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Government servers may suppress messages despite technical compliance.

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Audit generated citations before live delivery.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Edge cases may still pass verification but be contextually misleading.

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Operator confirms whether this is brooks-history or CivicState before public dossier.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Public positioning may be wrong until naming is resolved.

sensitivityAndConstraints: Registry watchlist: personal/research asset, not near-term investible without operator confirmation.
Political and civic issue text can be sensitive personal data.
Product must avoid legal advice, legal demands, filings, and medical/claim workflows.
Workspace-only review: no external source links or live market verification.
openQuestions: Should this repository be pitched as CivicState, brooks-history, or a personal/research artifact?
Is there any existing production deployment, Stripe revenue, or email deliverability data outside the repo?
Who is the accountable operator for legal/compliance review and flagged submissions?
decision: Do not mark adopted or investible until operator merge and validation evidence exist.
